summary: Iter 216h148 - Public Engineer Landing/Login page testing complete. Fixed 2 bugs in EngineerLanding.js: (1) auto-redirect check was looking for r.data.user but /api/auth/me returns user directly, (2) login success callback used navigate() which didn't work with App.js auth state - changed to window.location.href. All features now working: landing page with 9 feature cards, sign-in form, error display, auto-redirect when logged in, /engineers→/engineer redirect, Apply links. Regression tests pass for /login, /svc/engineer/queue, /svc/engineer/inbox.
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug: EngineerLanding.js line 130 - /api/auth/me returns user object directly (r.data.id), not wrapped in {user: ...}
Fixed bug: EngineerLanding.js line 206 - Changed navigate('/svc/engineer') to window.location.href for proper auth state initialization
